translations.web: The multitude will be lifted up, and his heart will be exalted. He will cast down tens of thousands, but he won’t prevail.
translations.bsb: When the army is carried off, the king of the South will be proud in heart and will cast down tens of thousands, but he will not triumph.
translations.kjv: And when he hath taken away the multitude, his heart shall be lifted up; and he shall cast down many ten thousands: but he shall not be strengthened
